title: Figures 99-100: cylinder UAP temperature and Mach number at 400 mph CFD plots
description: Two CFD contour plots for the cylinder UAP at 1/6 scale, 223K and 400 mph with subsonic inlet and subsonic outlet. Figure 99 shows the temperature/pressure field around the body; Figure 100 shows Mach number with accelerated flow around the cylinder flanks and a slow wake core. BAASS cylinder aerodynamics series.
